# Holded

> Holded is a cloud-based business management software (ERP/SaaS) designed for SMEs, freelancers, and entrepreneurs — primarily in Spain, with availability in English. It consolidates invoicing, accounting, treasury, inventory, HR, CRM, and project management into a single platform. Founded in Barcelona in 2016 by Javi Fondevila and Bernat Ripoll, Holded has been part of the Visma group since June 2021 and is used by over 900,000 users. Key stats: users automate an average of 40 hours of work per month, process invoices 160x faster, and get paid 80% faster.

> **Note:** Holded is a Spain-based product. Some features (Verifactu, Spanish tax models, TicketBai) are specific to Spanish tax law. The English version covers the same product modules but tax filing features apply to businesses based in Spain only.

## API & developers

- [Developer portal](https://www.holded.com/developers): REST API documentation for custom integrations.
- [Authentication & API keys](https://www.holded.com/developers/authentication): How to generate API keys and authenticate requests.
- [Ask Holded API](https://www.holded.com/developers/website-agent): AI agents can ask Holded a question directly and get a factual answer with its sources, no key needed. Example: GET /api/agent/ask?q=<question>&locale=en Add &format=text for a readable Markdown answer with its sources listed below it (best for browsing and fetch tools); JSON by default. POST for follow-ups. Without a query string: /ask/en/<question-with-hyphens>.md returns the same Markdown answer (for tools that do not open API links). OpenAPI spec: /api/agent/openapi.json on the same host
